messages.text: BL-1817 🎵 in progress — The property lane's suite-wide default per-test budget scales with the lane's own contention (forks and 1-minute load, the per-test helper's factor) from a 20000 ms base, never below it and never above 60000 ms, so the 124 subprocess-spawning property files that declare no timeout stop timing out one by one in full-lane runs; BL-932's 'never a lane-wide raise' is overturned by the human and its three asserting scenarios are retired
